enabled.description: FedRAMP profile switch. Selects the hardened value of every feature in templates/_fedramp.tpl, and refuses components the profile forbids (the legacy feature-server).

dtmfSourceValidation.description: DTMF source validation of sbc-inbound and sbc-outbound while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides the per-service keys.

statsEnabled.description: StatsD (vg-stats-collector, telegraf :8125) while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides stats.enabled.

apiBanStrictRanges.description: vg-api-ban fails the run on a malformed API_BAN_BANNED_RANGES entry while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.strictRanges.

apiBanMaxRedirects.description: Redirects vg-api-ban follows while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.maxRedirects.

apiBanTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of each vg-api-ban request in milliseconds while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.timeoutMs.

apiBanMaxBatches.description: Feed batches (250 addresses each) vg-api-ban reads while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides apiBan.maxBatches.

apiSessionKeyDigest.description: Digest vg-api-server derives session-revocation Redis keys with while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides api.sessionKeyDigest.

redisAuth.description: Password on redis-ha and a dedicated ACL user for update-api-ban-list while the FedRAMP profile is on. Overrides redisHa.vgAuth.enabled.

apiAuditLogTtlDays.description: Days vg-api-server keeps audit records while the FedRAMP profile is on (AU-11 requires at least 90). Overrides auditLogging.cleanup.ttlDays. Capped at 99999 so a values-file number cannot overflow on render.

dtmfSourceValidation.description: DTMF source validation of vg-rtpengine-utils. null renders nothing (library default). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.
DTMF source validation of vg-rtpengine-utils. null renders nothing (library default). Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

strictRanges.description: vg-api-ban fails the run on a malformed API_BAN_BANNED_RANGES entry. false logs and skips it. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

maxRedirects.description: Redirects vg-api-ban follows. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout of each vg-api-ban request in milliseconds. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

maxBatches.description: Feed batches (250 addresses each) vg-api-ban reads. Ignored while global.fedramp.enabled is true.

allowPrivateCustomUrls.description: TEST-ONLY: renders api-server's ALLOW_PRIVATE_CUSTOM_URLS SSRF escape hatch. Must never be enabled on production values. null (default) follows vgTestHarness.enabled; explicit true/false overrides.

sessionKeyDigest.description: Digest used to derive session-revocation Redis keys. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. null leaves the variable unset and vg-api-server keeps its default, md5. Changing this on a populated cluster relocates every stored session and needs a scale-to-zero cutover through api.replicaCount - see Cognigy/vg-api-server docs/fedramp-remediation-1-upgrade.md.

ttlDays.description: Days vg-api-server keeps audit records (AUDIT_LOG_TTL_DAYS). Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on. A whole number from 1 to 99999, as a number or a quoted string of digits; null leaves the variable unset. Zero, negative and non-numeric values are refused: vg-api-server images before #255 read a negative value as a window in the future and delete every audit record.

agenticEndpoint.description: Fallback for feature-server's dial-time agent routing only, used for an agent-targeted application that predates vg-api-server's per-application agentic_endpoint_hook column. vg-api-server itself no longer reads this.

pathPrefix.description: Path appended to the derived host. Must match vg-agentic-endpoint's ingress routePrefix + wsPath.

baseUrl.description: Host override for when the adapter isn't on the API host, same syntax as cognigyLogin.baseUrl (an http(s) URL, not a websocket one) — e.g. https://api-dev.cognigy.ai, no path. The scheme is normalized to ws(s):// and pathPrefix is appended automatically. Empty derives the host from cognigyLogin.baseUrl.

speechInterception.description: Whether the harness intercepts real speech-vendor traffic. 'none' (default) redirects nothing at the infrastructure level -- a custom:<name> credential still reaches mock-speech by the URL stored on the credential, needing nothing from this chart. 'vendor' makes VG dial the real vendor hostnames and rewrites them, in-namespace, to mock-speech's TLS listener -- deriving regionDns and its rewrite list, mockSpeech.tls and its certificate, the FreeSWITCH and api-server dnsConfig, and the CA-trust overlay.

numbers.description: Numbers the provisioner creates in VG MySQL (manifest mode). number must be a quoted string: an unquoted YAML number decodes as a float, which neither the provisioner nor the mock-runtime-api overlap guard can compare reliably.

organisations.description: Organisations that exist ONLY in the Cognigy.AI cluster, served by mock-runtime-api (CGY-38776). Their numbers must not also be provisioned into VG MySQL.

generate.description: Whether the chart mints mock-speech's CA and leaf itself (default true), reusing the existing Secret on upgrade so the CA is stable. Applies on the vendor route only: speechInterception=vendor derives the hostname list the leaf must cover. With mockSpeech.tls.enabled alone the Secret must be supplied from outside. Set false where a run mints its own and needs the CA outside the cluster.

caConfigMapName.description: ConfigMap holding the CA that signed mock-speech's leaf, mounted by the CA-trust overlay the chart renders on the vendor route. The chart creates it alongside the Secret when generate is true; with generate false it must exist before install.

speechVendor.description: Which vendor the provision Job points every provisioned application at. Every vendor is served simultaneously; this only selects what gets provisioned.

mockDeepgramRegion.description: DEPRECATED: superseded by the speech adapter (regionDns.rewrites -> mock-speech plus mockSpeech.tls). Kept so a namespace with its own rewrites still validates; the image pin is frozen because vg-test-harness deleted the binary.

rewrites.description: Hostnames test-dns answers for, and the in-namespace Service each resolves to. Point these at mock-speech for the speech adapter.

clusterIPBase.description: Dotted prefix, e.g. "172.20.0", that test-dns's ClusterIP is derived from when clusterIP is unset -- the last octet comes from the namespace name. Normally left empty: the chart defaults the prefix to kube-system/kube-dns's own /24, which Kubernetes reserves for pinned addresses and never allocates from dynamically. Set it only to override that choice.

carrierDefaultApplication.description: Whether the test carrier keeps a fallback application (default true). false only for the kindvgai suite (CGY-38776), whose legacy-miss fallback hangs off the no_gateway rejection this pin prevents.

enabled.description: Password on redis-ha and a dedicated ACL user for update-api-ban-list. Ignored while the FedRAMP profile is on (global.fedramp.redisAuth applies).
